tasks.title: Lecture #64
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in a music class.
tasks.transcript:
You are probably all familiar with jazz music. Its history begins in the southern United States. It originated in the early 20th century in the city of New Orleans, blending elements of different kinds of music like African rhythms, blues, and ragtime. One of the key characteristics of jazz is its emphasis on improvisation. Musicians often create spontaneous melodies and harmonies, making each performance unique. This contrast with classical music, where compositions are typically played as written. Jazz musicians also use syncopation, which involve shifting the normal accents in the rhythm to create an unexpected and exciting sound.
In the 1920s, jazz became widely popular and moved north to cities like Chicago and New York City. During the Jazz Age, as this period became known, famous jazz musicians like Louis Armstrong became household names, and jazz clubs flourished as social hubs. Over time, jazz continued to evolve, in part by incorporating elements from other musical traditions and cultures. Today, it remains a vibrant and influential genre, celebrated for its creativity and expressive power. Next, we will look at the impact of jazz on other musical genres and how it has shaped contemporary music.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the talk?

options.A: The development of jazz over time
options.C: The role of jazz clubs in social life
options.D: The popularity of jazz in the 1920s

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：这段谈话的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：Its history begins... originated in the early 20th century... In the 1920s... over time, jazz continued to evolve... Today, it remains... （全文按时间顺序讲述爵士乐的起源、发展、演变和现状） 选项分析： A. The development of jazz over time 爵士乐随时间的发展。谈话从起源到今日，讲述爵士乐的发展历程，所以A选项正确。 B. The most famous jazz musicians 最著名的爵士音乐家。谈话中提到Louis Armstrong，但不是主要内容，所以B选项错误。 C. The role of jazz clubs in social life 爵士俱乐部在社交生活中的作用。谈话中只提到一句爵士俱乐部作为社交中心繁荣，不是主要内容，所以C选项错误。 D. The popularity of jazz in the 1920s 爵士乐在1920年代的流行。这只是谈话中的一个阶段，不是整体主题，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what is a key characteristic of jazz music?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：根据说话者，爵士音乐的一个关键特征是什么？ 定位原文：One of the key characteristics of jazz is its emphasis on improvisation. 选项分析： A. Influences from classical music 来自古典音乐的影响。谈话中提到爵士与古典音乐形成对比（contrast），而非受其影响，所以A选项错误。 B. Improvisation 即兴创作。说话者明确说是关键特征之一，所以B选项正确。 C. Simple rhythms 简单的节奏。谈话中提到切分音（syncopation）创造意想不到的声音，并非简单节奏，所以C选项错误。 D. Lack of syncopation 缺乏切分音。谈话明确说爵士音乐家使用切分音，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention Chicago and New York City?

options.A: To explain the origins of some famous jazz musicians
options.B: To illustrate the spread of jazz to the northern United States
options.C: To give examples of contemporary centers of jazz
options.D: To describe the role of large cities in training jazz musicians

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者为什么提到芝加哥和纽约市？ 定位原文：In the 1920s, jazz became widely popular and moved north to cities like Chicago and New York City. 选项分析： A. To explain the origins of some famous jazz musicians 解释一些著名爵士音乐家的起源。谈话中未提及音乐家的起源地，所以A选项错误。 B. To illustrate the spread of jazz to the northern United States 说明爵士乐传播到美国北部。说话者说爵士乐“moved north”到芝加哥和纽约，所以B选项正确。 C. To give examples of contemporary centers of jazz 举例说明当代爵士乐中心。谈话讲的是1920年代的传播，不是当代，所以C选项错误。 D. To describe the role of large cities in training jazz musicians 描述大城市在培养爵士音乐家方面的作用。谈话中未提及培训，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What aspect of jazz will the speaker discuss next?

options.A: How it has lost some of its popularity
options.B: How it has influenced other forms of music
options.C: How it has changed since the 1920s
options.D: How it spread outside the United States

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者接下来将讨论爵士乐的哪个方面？ 定位原文：Next, we will look at the impact of jazz on other musical genres and how it has shaped contemporary music. 选项分析： A. How it has lost some of its popularity 它如何失去了一些流行度。谈话中未提及，所以A选项错误。 B. How it has influenced other forms of music 它如何影响了其他音乐形式。说话者明确说要看爵士对其他音乐类型的影响（impact on other musical genres），所以B选项正确。 C. How it has changed since the 1920s 自1920年代以来它如何变化。这部分已经在本讲中涉及，不是接下来要讲的，所以C选项错误。 D. How it spread outside the United States 它如何传播到美国以外。谈话中未提及，所以D选项错误。
